title: SuperM Answers K-Pop Questions From Twitter | Tech Support | WIRED
description: The members of SuperM use the power of Twitter to answer common questions about SuperM and K-pop. While doing so, Baekhyun, Taemin, Kai, Taeyong, Ten, Lucas, and Mark all say nice things about each other, reveal their favorite K-pop bands and talk about their all time favorite music videos. Some of the questions asked include: Are you ever too old to get into K-pop? What are the significance of light sticks in K-pop? Are K-pop music videos addictive?     #슈퍼엠 #SuperM    The second half of the SuperM: We Are The Future Tour kicks off January 30, 2020 in San Diego. Listen to the group's first mini album, SuperM here: https://superm.lnk.to/SuperMIn    Still haven’t subscribed to WIRED on YouTube? ►► http://wrd.cm/15fP7B7   Get more incredible stories on science and tech with our daily newsletter: https://wrd.cm/DailyYT    Also, check out the free WIRED channel on Roku, Apple TV, Amazon Fire TV, and Android TV. Here you can find your favorite WIRED shows and new episodes of our latest hit series Tradecraft.    ABOUT WIRED  WIRED is where tomorrow is realized. Through thought-provoking stories and videos, WIRED explores the future of business, innovation, and culture.  SuperM Answers K-Pop Questions From Twitter | Tech Support | WIRED

Hashtag Ask SuperM Can you describe the member next to you with one word? Handsome! Oh my god! Okay, true, okay Kai, Kai hyung Uh... Good Good one one please Good one? Okay Tennis lie Cat? Ah no It's not cat What did you say? Fox? Fox Fox Friend Genius Oh Good Good Friend Genius Good! Good! Good! He's like a cartoon character Sometimes he reminds me of Gingerbread Man You know from track? Gingerbread? You know, Gingerbread Man I watched the track anime He's similar to Gingerbread? You know, Gingerbread Man. I watched the last anime. He's similar to Gingerbread Man. I guess he's like that because he took it off. I'm curious. Who was the first group that introduced you to K-pop and do you still stand in now? I respected Rain. He doesn't really sing a lot now, but he got married. But I still know him. BoA is so pretty Oh, that's right So for me it's BoA and SHINee And for me, SHINee TVXQ Do you have one? You do? Me? I really... I'm not saying this because I have one When I was in Canada, I listened to Juliet a lot Really,te when I was in Canada Really, really I told you that before And the next question is from Tay Tatat What's your favorite music video? Doesn't have to be K-pop Oh That's hard I was so into Rosalia, right? All of her videos are very... Like the colors and the concept are very interesting So I keep looking through all her music videos. What do you like about Taeyong? I love Justin Timberlake, Suit and Tie. Oh, Suit and Tie. Featuring Jay-Z. I like Chris Brown's Turn Up The Music and Fine China. Oh! I really watch Tempo a lot. Don't mess up my tempo. Really. I watch this. Famous. Famous. Famous. Alright. We should watch it. We're all fans of each other, so. Alright. Star Angelica. I think I know what it is! Pen lights represent the color of each team. That's how you show your identity. Something like that. Our lightstick is pink. And we chose pink because we represent our label SM And SM's color is pink So we use that as our lightstick Slightly! With an exclamation mark Does anyone find K-pop music videos really addictive? Like you come back and want to watch the same video more and more Um, thank you But I watch our music videos. I watch them often. So do I. I turn on the playback on my iPad. I've never watched my music video. Wow. Kai says he's never seen his own music video more than once. The next question is from Hallyu website. What are the best three K-pop music videos that had come out so far this year? Pick one. Pick only three. Yeah. Dropping, Moonwalk, Want. Yeah. For me, NCT Dream, Boom. Ah, Boom Boom Boom Boom boom boom boom boom boom boom I know one Mine is Taemin hyung, famous Famous! Oh, right, famous came out I like NCT 127's Superhuman Yo! So me is like Taemin famous Taeyong likes NCT Dream boom And then Paik hyung and NCT 127 Super Hero. This one's from Siazana. Let's go. Addicted to K-Pop dance practice videos, especially those with intense routines. Complicated, synchronized, sharp, on point, beautiful genius choreography. How do they do that? Hashtag impressed. It depends on how much you practice. I think it depends on how much you practice. And more importantly, I think there are a chemistry between us as we do everything together. Oh… There's no practice. I think these things will be shown through our teamwork. Next one, next one. softJEN Is dancing alone to K-Pop songs in your apartment considered as workout? I think, I think so. you can still call it a workout because you know, you're moving your body. It actually requires a lot, you know some more energy to dance, so On this day in K-pop, what's a K-pop lyric you always have stuck in your head? Confession. Confession. She likes danger and I like her. That was a song called Dangerous Woman. It hasn't been released yet, but if you come to the tour, you can listen to it. Oh yeah. So the next question is from Shayville. Am I too old to get into K-pop? It's pretty fun. No, I think K-pop is for all ages though. You don't need to be young to love K-pop. It's like all over the place. You can. Every age can love K-pop. K-pop has no age limit. No age limit. You can do it. You're not too old. TAEYONG, you to read this out for us Okay, question is... Purimpire, right? Poo-rim-pire? Pure Empire? Oh, Pure Empire Pure Empire Pure Empire Okay, Pure Empire Okay What was your motivation to becoming an idol? I ended up getting out this way. I started like that, too. And then I went to family… For me, it was a step up, too. I watched a movie, and I started dancing as my hobby. And then my grandmother really influenced me to become a K-Pop idol because she kept showing me Super Junior, That's where she got me. I love singing before I became an idol but after being an idol I felt like I didn't want to be like that. It means that you can be hopeful without being a teenager. You should be something that you have to give strength to in your hardships. But, in the end, I think I have the means to make a difference in my career And I want to keep bringing a meaning to it Hey guys this is WIRED's K-pop Support See you next time!

The discussion of age, light sticks, a tour, and an album link is presented as cultural, fandom-oriented commentary and ordinary music promotion, without requests for payment, private data, investment participation, or other consequential action.
annotation.fine_grained_rationale: The central context is general entertainment and lifestyle discussion about K-pop music, artists, music videos, fan items and dance practice, rather than a scam mechanism or a consequential action flow.
